title: Yellowed Chewy Malaysian Oxtail Stew
description: A resinous and chewy Malaysian dish featuring oxtail, this recipe is a show-off dish that is dairy-free friendly and cooked to perfection in an iron teppan, the namul-blanch-season method ensures the oxtail is tender and full of flavor.
instructions: Heat the iron teppan over medium high heat and add the vegetable oil.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the oxtail pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the soy sauce, coconut milk, star anise, cinnamon stick, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2 1/2 hours.
Remove the star anise and cinnamon stick, and serve the stew hot.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve with steamed rice or noodles.
